messages:
pagerbot: ALERT: elevated error-rate and queue backlog for function-calls and structured responses in eu-west-1. 5m error-rate 14%, queue depth increased x6. paging eng-oncall.
Sam (oncall): grabbing it. confirm whether this is new deploy or load spike.
Lee (eng-sre): no deploys in the last hour. traffic shows a sudden increase in requests with `function_calling: true` + large tool payloads. worker queues pile up and some runtimes start rejecting.
Priya (runtime): runtime heap pressure on pool-eu-3, GC thrash observed. function call marshalling path is hot. suspect big tool manifests + structured output serialization.
Sam (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) enable short-term global soft-block on function calls (accept but respond with 429 for new heavy-call requests) 2) toggle structured_output -> minimal text for streaming clients 3) apply per-api-key short quota caps. can we enact?
Cam (devex): global soft-block will break some integrations but better than full outage. Add SDK banner so clients get a graceful error.
Mei (cs): we have ~5 customers with high concurrency in eu-west using function calls. I can send AS-AP messages. need wording and ETA.
deploybot: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/functioncall-overload 

Lee (eng-sre): applying middleware limiter now: `fncall.rejection_mode=soft` and `fncall.max_payload_size=64KB`. CLI:```bash
# enable soft reject for function calls
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/configs/global
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -d '{"fncall.rejection_mode":"soft","fncall.max_payload_size":"65536"}'
```
Priya (runtime): also lowering structured_output serialization threads to 2 and switching fallback to text for schema paths. rolling restart of pool-eu-3 nodes (3/3).
Sam (oncall): apply per-key quota for top offenders (api-abc, api-xyz). use 8 rps for 20m window.
Lee (eng-sre): applied quotas. snippet:```bash
# cap API key api-abc
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/apikeys/api-abc/limits
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -d '{"rps":8,"duration_seconds":1200}'
```
Mei (cs): drafting notice: "We are mitigating increased errors for function-calling and structured JSON outputs in eu-west. We've applied temporary caps and graceful fallbacks; expected improvement within 15-30m. Will update when cleared." send?
Sam (oncall): send now, include known impacted API keys.
Cam (devex): also push an SDK update note to accept `X-Structured-Fallback: true` header and treat 429 as retryable with backoff. filing quick doc patch.
Priya (runtime): after soft-reject + payload cap, queue depth down 55%, error-rate down to 5.3% within 90s. GC cycles normalized.
Lee (eng-sre): we still see a small population of long-lived requests that attempt to stream full schema + multiple nested tools. propose temporary middleware trimming: `max_tool_items=2` and `trim_mode=warn_and_strip`.
Sam (oncall): implement trimming and include response header `X-Tools-Trimmed: 1` when trimmed.
Priya (runtime): trimming applied. request samples show removed ~40% of payload length in heavy requests. p95 latency for affected path down to 420ms.
Mei (cs): one customer (api-xyz) replied: "This affects our parsing pipeline, can you escalate?" I replied: "We applied temporary caps and trimming; we will revert when stable and follow up with exact timeline."
Cam (devex): recommend persistent guardrail: SDK warn when `function_calling=true` and concurrency > 50. creating ticket DEVEX-391.
Sam (oncall): handoff: Lee to monitor next 45m; I will stay reachable for 10m then hand to day oncall. If regression, escalate to @Rita and open P1.
Lee (eng-sre): taken. I lowered the schema-path alert threshold to p90>1s and set a dedicated dashboard.
Sam (oncall): also note for postmortem: evaluate adding autoscaling for schema serializer workers and consider a lightweight streaming-only code path that avoids full serialization.
Priya (runtime): agree. also propose a circuit-breaker to automatically reject function calls above cluster-wide concurrency threshold.
Lee (eng-sre): current metrics: error-rate 2.6%, queue depth near baseline. leaving quotas and soft-rejects in place for 20m and then we can incrementally relax.
Mei (cs): sent follow-up to impacted customers with ETA 30m. flagged the one needing manual follow-up.
Sam (oncall): summary pinned: enacted soft-reject for fncalls, applied payload caps, per-key RPS caps, trimmed nested tool manifests, switched structured output to fallback text for schema path, rolling restarts of eu pool. incident will remain open until 2432157800 for verification. Thanks. :thumbsup:
pagerbot: Next automated check at 2432155855 (300s) per runbook cadence.
